root_cause: The shared Checkbox snapshotted initialValue once at setup; the edit gate read a null permissions blob as no-rights.

design_decisions.title: Fix Checkbox itself rather than add a fourth key workaround
design_decisions.decision: Added a watch on initialValue in the shared Checkbox and removed the keyed-remount workarounds.
design_decisions.rationale: Three keyed-remount workarounds already existed for this missing watch; a key also discards focus. Only 3 files render <Checkbox>.
design_decisions.reviewer_must_confirm: Agree the component is the right fix point?

design_decisions.title: The watch does NOT emit change
design_decisions.decision: Prop sync does not emit change.
design_decisions.rationale: change means the user toggled this; echoing a push would loop.

design_decisions.title: Resolve the edit gate against an EMPTY permission set when the blob is null after loading
design_decisions.decision: Null blob after load resolves through an empty permission set.
design_decisions.rationale: Absent blob means no grants recorded; matches the permission service's short-circuit.

design_decisions.title: Add an explicit loading flag instead of overloading the null blob
design_decisions.decision: New loading flag; dialog shows Loading permissions...

design_decisions.title: Also add !canEditPermissions to the Owners row's disabled state
design_decisions.decision: Owners row now carries the same gate as its siblings.

design_decisions.title: Track a failed load separately (loadFailed) and fail CLOSED
design_decisions.decision: A failed load keeps the dialog read-only with an error; Save not rendered.
design_decisions.rationale: Treating a failure as no-grants would let an owner's full-replacement Save wipe every grant.

design_decisions.title: Add projects.getRevision() and express getRevisionPermissions() on top of it
design_decisions.decision: New service method so the modal can tell a failed request from a grant-less revision.

design_decisions.title: Also retire PrintProjectModal's key workaround and its now-false comment
Give the Edit checkboxes the same value-bearing key as the View ones
design_decisions.reviewer_must_confirm: Confirm the component fix over the key?

design_decisions.title: Switch Checkbox to a controlled checked prop
design_decisions.rationale: Breaking API change to a widely used shared component.

design_decisions.title: Keep the empty-set fallback unconditional and rely on the server
design_decisions.rationale: The server would NOT reject an owner's wipe.
